topic: What antenna aperture size trade-offs exist between LEO and GEO satellites when optimizing gain and portability for CMOS-based ground terminals?
consensus_response: LEO satellites require smaller aperture sizes for portability and rapid tracking, leveraging beamforming and phased arrays to enhance gain. In contrast, GEO satellites utilize larger apertures for higher gain, sacrificing portability. Polarization diversity and beam hopping techniques further optimize performance, balancing gain, portability, and signal quality.
reference_context: LEO and GEO satellites have different orbit characteristics, affecting antenna design and signal transmission, with LEO requiring more complex tracking and GEO allowing for fixed positions.
